name: Loaf
purpose: Selected UCLI cat logo for README and project identity
selection: Owner preferred Loaf from the reviewed options on2026-10-19
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one fresh finished cat logo for UCLI, a comfortable universal command-line tool for AI agents. Design direction: LOAF, a relaxed sleepy black cat seen in side/three-quarter view lying low with paws tucked under its body, long tail curling gently beside it. The whole-cat silhouette, distinctive pointed ears, a tiny cream snout, and two simple relaxed closed eyes make it recognizably feline at a glance. Understated, cozy, playful indie developer identity. Elegant soft organic curves, not a geometric shield or symmetrical generic head. One or two flat solid colors: almost-black inky plum and warm off-white for essential facial details. The silhouette must remain recognizable as a favicon at 24px. Flat crisp professional illustration that is vector-friendly, substantial clean shapes, visually balanced, no outlines around a badge, no terminal symbols, no chevrons, no letters, no laptop, no text, no gradients, no 3D, no shadows, no orange/coral cat-head treatment. Show exactly one large centered cat mark with generous transparent padding, no presentation board. Genuinely transparent background.
